agenda_text:
SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  Terry Kistler, Chair
Scott Snider, Vice Chair  Jenny Jolly, Committee Member
George Borst, Committee Member  Mary Smith, Committee Member
Edward Padgett, Committee Member  Bette Donovan Committee Member

  Wednesday, September 16, 2026
  Regular Meeting at 10:00 AM
  La Verne Community Center
  3680 D Street, La Verne, CA 91750
Attendance and participation at the City of La Verne Senior Advisory Committee meetings are
welcomed and appreciated. Community engagement provides the Committee with valuable
information. In compliance with the American Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who
requires a modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the City
Clerk’s Office at (909) 596-8726 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

Persons addressing the Senior Advisory Committee shall be limited to 3 minutes unless an extension
of time is granted by the Chair, subject to approval of the Committee Members. When any group of
persons wishes to address the Committee, it shall be proper for the Chair to request that a
spokesperson be chosen to represent the group.

Public comments will be allowed on items on this Agenda at the time each item is considered.

Mission of the Senior Advisory Committee
To plan for coordinated delivery of services to senior citizens to eliminate duplication and conflict of
effort, as well as to inform its seniors of the availability of programs.

CALL TO ORDER AND PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

PRESENTATIONS

1.  None.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES

2.  Wednesday, August 19, 2026

DISCUSSION ITEMS

3.
  a. Senior Meals Program
  b. Meals on Wheels Program
  c. Committee Terms
 AGENDA  Senior Citizen Advisory Committee 9/16/2026  Page 2

  d. Bingo Report
  e. Account Balance Update
  f. Monthly Senior Program Fees Update
  g. Mt. SAC Classes Update
  h. Outstanding Older American
  i. Aging Next
  j. Facilities Report
  k. Upcoming Events

PUBLIC COMMENT
Public comments will be allowed on items not on the Agenda but within the subject matter jurisdiction
of the Committee; however, no action may be taken on off-agenda items except as provided by law.

STAFF/COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION & INFORMATION
Committee members may ask a question for clarification, make a brief announcement, make a brief
report on his/her own activities, request staff to report back at a subsequent meeting concerning any
matter, or take action to direct staff to place a matter of business on a future agenda.

ADJOURNMENT

The next regularly scheduled meeting of the Senior Advisory Committee will be held at
  10:00 AM on Wednesday, October 21, 2026, at the La Verne Community Center.

Posting Statement: A true copy of this Agenda was posted on Thursday, September 10,
2026, on the bulletin board at La Verne City Hall, 3660 D Street, La Verne, and on the City’s
website at www.laverneca.gov.

MINUTES OF THE SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  REGULAR MEETING
  Wednesday, September 16, 2026

  ACTION MINUTES
  “See items in italics”
  _________________________________________________________________

1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee was called to order at:
  10:00 AM on Wednesday, September 16, 2026.

  Members present: Terry Kistler, Jenny Jolly, George Borst, Scott Snider, Bette
  Donovan.

  Members Absent: Mary Smith, Edward Padgett.

  Staff Present: Yvonne Duran, Parks & Recreation Director, Armando Cisneros,
  Parks & Recreation Specialist, Robyn Olsen, Parks & Recreation Specialist.

  It was moved by Scott Snider and seconded by Terry Kistler to approve the
  minutes of Wednesday, August 19, 2026 meeting. Motion carried.

2. Guest Speaker: None.

  Unfinished Business

3. Senior Nutrition Program:

  Congregate Meals: 573 meals were served to an average of 27 participants in
  August.

  Meals on Wheels: N/A.:

4. Bingo Report: Receipts for August 2026 totaled $9,840.00 (rent to City of La
  Verne $400.00; Bingo West $1,040.00; Payouts $8,400.00). Attendance over 4
  dates was 320 participants.

5. Account Balance: N/A.

6. Senior Program Fees: All program fees are paid.

7. MT. SAC Classes: Mt. Sac is currently in fall session.
 8. Aging Next: Total number of La Verne residents served for the month of
  August 2026 was 9.

New Business

9. Facilities Report: The remodel of the Senior Craft room has begun.

10. Upcoming Events

  •  Tuesday, September 22nd – Health and Resource Fair, 9:00AM – 11:30AM.
  •  Wednesday, September 23rd – Senior Seminar: Cyber Security Awareness, Presented by
  Independence at Home, 10:30AM.
  •  Tuesday, September 29th – Excursion: Anacapa Wildlife Cruise & Ventura Harbor Village, 7:00AM –
  6:30PM.
  •  Sunday, October 4th – Excursion: Big Bear Lake Oktoberfest, 9:30AM – 6:00PM.
  •  Wednesday, October 7th – Senior Seminar: Domestic Violence Awareness, Presented by the YWCA,
  10:30AM.
  •  Saturday, October 10th – Craft Fair, 9:00AM – 1:00PM.
  •  Monday, October 12th – Movie Matinee, Eternity, 12:30PM.
  •  Wednesday, October 14th – Senior Seminar: Medicare 101 and Changes to Expect in 2027,
  Presented by the Embrace Health Insurance, 10:30AM.
  •  Thursday, October 15th – Excursion: Workman & Temple Family Homestead and Mission San
  Gabriel, 9:15AM – 5:30PM.

  Public Comments: Bingo changed table arrangements and entry.

  Adjourn: The meeting was adjourned at 10:30AM. The next meeting will be held on
  Wednesday, October 21, 2026.

  Submitted by:
  Armando Cisneros
  Parks & Recreation Specialist
